verdict.rationale: Conductor is a Mac GUI app that spins up local git worktrees and gives each task its own local terminal, running Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/OpenCode locally (docs-1, docs-2), and community confirms it operates via local git worktrees and the local Claude Code SDK (conductor-comm-15, conductor-comm-17). However, this is a desktop-app-orchestrated experience rather than a true terminal-native/CLI-first workflow, and some cloud-workspace features move execution off-machine (conductor-docs-20). Missing for 10: a documented CLI entry point to invoke Conductor itself from the terminal, and clearer evidence the embedded terminal is a full first-class local dev shell rather than a log/output pane.
